component.name: Dialog
component.description: Modal overlay in two forms: a standard centered modal for short forms (sm/default sizes), and a full-page variant with no backdrop tint for the run detail view.

commonPatterns.name: new-task-form
commonPatterns.composition: <Dialog isOpen={open} onClose={close} title="New Task" size="sm" footer={<Button appearance="primary">Create</Button>}>...</Dialog>

commonPatterns.name: run-detail-page
commonPatterns.description: The full-page variant, offset by the sidebar, no backdrop.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Dialog for non-blocking supplementary content
antiPatterns.reason: a dialog interrupts the user's flow
antiPatterns.alternative: Use an inline side-section in the existing page

antiPatterns.scenario: Dismissing a dialog with unsaved input without confirming
antiPatterns.alternative: Confirm before calling onClose when the form is dirty

commonPartners: Card (opens the full-size variant on click)
parentConstraints: Rendered via a portal to document.body — no DOM nesting constraint

interactions.backdrop-click: closes the dialog (sm/default only — full has no backdrop)

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Escape closes; focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close
accessibility.focusManagement: focus moves to dialog content on open; the full variant is still a dismissible overlay semantically despite reading as a page

aiHints.context: Use size="sm"/"default" for forms and confirmations; size="full" only for page-level content like the run detail view.
